name: Khazna DXB8 Jebel Ali data center
notes: Listed as a 12.5MW Tier III facility in the Jebel Ali area, operational since 2021; assigned to Dubai Sector 5 because Sector 5 includes Jebel Ali industrial and coastal districts.

name: Khazna DXB3 Ibn Battuta data center
notes: Khazna announced DXB3 at Ibn Battuta, with DXB2 and DXB3 jointly totaling 43MW IT load; PeeringDB lists the facility at Ibn Battuta, Jebel Ali. DXB3 was planned to begin operations in Q1 2024, so status is treated as operational but individual MW was not disclosed.

name: Khazna DXB9 hyperscale Tier III facility
notes: Delivery-partner source describes DXB9 as a hyperscale Tier III facility delivering 30MW; USGBC lists Khazna Data Center DXB09 at the Etisalat Jebel Ali Earth Station site, placing it in Sector 5.

name: VOLT UAE / DIEZ AI-ready data center at Dubai Silicon Oasis
developer: VOLT UAE; Dubai Integrated Economic Zones Authority; Schneider Electric support
notes: Official Dubai Media Office announcement says DIEZ and VOLT UAE formed a JV to develop AI-ready data centres in Dubai Silicon Oasis; trade press reports 29MW first phase and potential expansion to 129MW. Dubai Silicon Oasis is in central/eastern Dubai, treated here as Sector 6 coverage.

name: Gulf Data Hub Dubai Silicon Oasis campus
notes: Vertiv case study says GDH operates six data centers within Dubai Silicon Oasis, beginning with a 4MW facility and including three facilities of 16MW each; total shown is minimum specifically disclosed capacity, not full campus capacity.

name: Equinix DX3 Dubai IBX
notes: Equinix lists DX3 as one of its Dubai data centers; DCD reported the first phase opened with 900 racks and $60m investment. Nearby/campus references place it with DX1/DX2 around IMPZ/Dubai Production City, treated as Sector 6.

name: Moro Hub Warsan Green Data Centre
notes: DEWA reported construction progress at Moro Hub's new Green Data Centre in Warsan with overall capacity exceeding 100MW; USGBC has a Moro Hub Warsan Phase 1 data-center project listing. Warsan coverage is mapped to Sector 8 due to the batch sector geography including Warsan 3.

name: Moro Hub Green Data Centre at Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park
notes: DEWA announced inauguration of the solar-powered data centre in 2023 and second phase in 2025; other DEWA material states full buildout target of 100MW. Located at MBR Solar Park in Saih Al-Dahal, mapped to Dubai Sector 9's southern non-urban/Al Marmoom area.

name: e& SmartHub Fujairah campus fourth Tier III facility
notes: e& announced launch of a fourth Tier III facility at Fujairah SmartHub; new 1.5MW expansion brings total campus capacity to 4MW and is directly connected to the cable landing station.

division: Ras Al Khaimah - Ras Al Khaimah
name: Siada sovereign AI data center at Innovation City Ras Al Khaimah
developer: Siada; Innovation City Ras Al Khaimah
notes: DCD reported a data center launched inside Innovation City in Ras Al Khaimah to power sovereign cloud; size and capacity were not disclosed. DataCenterMap lists Siada Ras Al-Khaimah in Innovation City Free Zone for NVIDIA B200 GPU AI workloads.

name: Hamriyah Free Zone Authority internal data center upgrade
developer: Hamriyah Free Zone Authority; Future Technology
notes: Integrator case study says Huawei FusionModule800 Data Centre and Aruba networking were supplied, installed, and configured at Al Hamriyah Free Zone Authority in Sharjah over three months. This appears to be an enterprise/internal data center rather than a commercial colocation site.
